name: main-sma
title_zh: 拆开即用的 11 件套，每件都替你踩过坑
tagline_zh: 不是技能合集，是 11 个已经调通的手艺。装完不用配环境、不用读 README，直接喊它干活，省下你一下午的试错。
tagline_en: Not a skill pack—11 working trades. No setup, no README, just call and get it done. Saves you an afternoon of.
why_zh: 每个 skill 都自带边界声明和失败提示，装完就知道它能管到哪、管不到哪，不装糊涂。
why_en: Each skill ships with explicit boundaries and failure hints—you know exactly what it covers and what it won't fake.
limit_zh: 只覆盖仓库作者实际用过的 11 个场景；超出清单的活它不会硬接，会直接告诉你没这技能。装前先看清单里有没有你要的那件。
limit_en: Covers only the 11 scenarios the author actually used. Outside that list, it won't fake it—it'll say so. Check the list before installing.

install.note: clone 下来，挑你要的那件复制进 ~/.claude/skills/。这是一个合集，没有「装它」这个动作。
